items.title: 67520_George Handy oral history interview
items.q: Hal went and rejoined them, because he had been with them until I pulled him out of the band to come to the coast with me.

ctx.x: L.A., I was living in L.A. and I decided to stay there.

(Johnny) Bothwell had had an argument with probably the rest of the band, because he was quite a character and Boyd finally told him he'd have to go and he called McKusick who was living with me, and Hal went and rejoined them, because he had been with them until I pulled him out of the band to come to the coast with me.
To work at Paramount at the studios?
